units.counting: 237 final distinct passing unit cases combines install 13, first-run controller 65, and corrected worker 159. No single 237-test combined run is claimed; the initial 158 worker passes are not counted again.

preservedFailures.test: releases a stalled cached stream at the worker deadline without downloading or leaving the query slot occupied
preservedFailures.cause: The worker captured setTimeout when environment() installed it, before this test enabled vi.useFakeTimers(); advancing the fake clock therefore did not fire the worker's captured real timer.
preservedFailures.correction: Moved vi.useFakeTimers() before environment() construction in this one worker test. No product source changed for this correction.
preservedFailures.finalValidation: Only affected worker file rerun: 159/159 pass; controller 65/65 retained from the first run.

integrity.newCommandsDuringAggregation: Read source evidence, compare artifact identities, copy whitelisted files and verify SHA256 only. No tests, builds or browsers rerun.

rawLogPreservation.note: Original *.log files are ignored by Git. The referenced JSON wrappers preserve exact bytes and provide the versionable evidence; original copiedFiles entries remain provenance receipts.

limitations: Internal focused S03 evidence only; no S03/S00-S40 acceptance, global BIL completion or production RC claim.
RU/EN device copy remains implementation draft pending synchronized editorial review.
Chrome desktop and Pixel 7 emulation do not establish Safari, physical-device or OS-installed-PWA behavior.
Offline readiness covers the current base files at check time. It does not extend entitlement, promise future browser retention or include optional packages.
Storage estimates are approximate and origin-wide; accepted installation choice and simulated denial are separate from real browser/OS evidence.
Raw worker process transcripts and raw first typecheck output were not independently saved; their existing tool-result records are preserved honestly.
Actual screenshots and browser checks belong to a1. Final a2 has the documented low-impact color delta and strict artifact audit, with zero browser replay.
Original ignored *.log paths in provenance receipts may be absent from a Git checkout. Use raw-log-preservation.json mappings and lossless JSON wrappers to read or reconstruct those exact logs.
